**[P2] Do not dispatch end hooks to plugins whose start hook never ran**

This catch also handles `KeyboardInterrupt`, `SystemExit`, or `GeneratorExit` raised by an `on_invocation_start` hook. Because `_create_plugins` populated every instance before start hooks are dispatched, the subsequent `on_invocation_end` call reaches plugins later in the list even though their start hook was never invoked. Their teardown may consume uninitialized state or perform invalid side effects. Track the prefix of plugins whose start hook was entered and dispatch this failure end only to that set; cover a first plugin raising a control exception with a later lifecycle-tracking plugin.
